newsitem.title: UK: BT/MCI deal could emerge on Sunday - sources.
newsitem.headline: BT/MCI deal could emerge on Sunday - sources.

text.p: A deal to clinch a $22 billion merger between British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp could be announced on Sunday, sources close to the talks said on Saturday.
A BT spokesman would say only that the company's board was meeting in London on Saturday and that a meeting of the MCI board had just begun in Washington.
He said the BT board was meeting at its corporate headquarters in central London and a large number of advisers, bankers and lawyers were also at work in the building.

BT is anticipating a proposal from MCI on a strategic merger. Analysts are speculating that BT could pay $40 a share for the 80 percent of MCI it does not own -- leaving it with a total bill of $22.1 billion.

The companies have said that a further announcement is anticipated before the London stock market opens on Monday. The unnamed sources said something could be announced in London around lunchtime on Sunday.
Both BT and MCI have said there can be no assurances that an agreement will be entered into or that any transaction will be consummated.
